Package servlets

Interface Servlet

All Known Implementing Classes:
ConfLoader, HtmlLoader, TopicDisplayer
public interface Servlet
Contract for a request handler registered with MyHTTPServer.

Each servlet is mapped to an HTTP method and a URI prefix. When an incoming request matches, the server calls handle(RequestInfo, OutputStream) on the appropriate servlet instance.

Servlets must be thread-safe: the server may invoke handle from different worker threads concurrently.
